label: Approximate age, capped at 90 years

domain: Prior fluids, organ support, and urine output
label: Recorded prior saline volume
definition: mL from completed, recorded main saline input records before t0 in this ICU episode. Incomplete total exposure ascertainment.

domain: Prior fluids, organ support, and urine output
label: Recorded prior lactated Ringer's volume
definition: mL from completed, recorded main LR input records before t0 in this ICU episode. Incomplete total exposure ascertainment.

domain: Prior fluids, organ support, and urine output
label: Maximum documented ongoing saline rate
definition: Maximum positive recorded rate in mL/hour among qualifying pre-documented ongoing saline continuous-IV records. Zero if none. Not summed rate or delivered volume.

domain: Prior fluids, organ support, and urine output
label: Maximum documented ongoing lactated Ringer's rate
definition: Maximum positive recorded rate in mL/hour among qualifying pre-documented ongoing LR continuous-IV records. Zero if none. Not summed rate or delivered volume.

domain: Prior fluids, organ support, and urine output
label: Recorded net urine volume, previous 6 hours
definition: Six-hour recorded net urine volume in mL, using pretreatment event and recording times and subtracting irrigation inflow. Missing if unobserved, negative, or above the analyst quarantine threshold of 6000 mL. Raw summaries remain in the private endpoint_linked_source staging table; upper threshold is not a validated physiological limit.

domain: Prior fluids, organ support, and urine output
label: Latest oxygen-delivery device
definition: Latest documented oxygen-delivery device string in the preceding six hours.

domain: Prior fluids, organ support, and urine output
label: Charted evidence of renal replacement therapy
definition: Any active-dialysis chart evidence recorded in prior six hours. Zero is no evidence, not confirmed absence of RRT.
